status_detail: The stage gate reading cannot be moved by span supervision; 0 of the 32,256.6 CPU six-cell dose was spent. Owner ruling required before any further training.
order_followed: pricing first (0 Adam), then low-update validation, then preflight, then stop for attribution

pricing.method: 19.5 measured slopes (selection 4.0 / copy 10.0 / joint 29.0 CPU per update) plus explicit non-train line items; the 5.4 flat rate was not reused

methodology_correction_19_3.root_cause: flat 5.4 CPU/update applied to all 300 updates; the measured second half is 20.8-26.7 CPU/update all-in, and the step0/step150 light plus step300 full evaluations (about 344 + 732 CPU per cell) were priced as negligible

low_update_validation.design: seed 28031, arms A_route_lock and B_stop_lock, 30 updates each, selection stage only, span bottleneck 32
low_update_validation.measurement_note: The two arms produced bit-identical traces and an identical candidate_sha_v2 (6c5466ab...), because arm type only enters the copy/joint window; this 60 Adam is effectively one 30-update trajectory run twice. The reported start_hit is the beta reading of the frozen reader, so it cannot respond to span supervision; the span CE drop is the only reading in this report that measures the supervised quantity.

pointer_diagnostic.reading: gold start offset of the object/place record, teacher-forced prefix; beta_argmax is the 19.5 start_hit basis, pointer_logits/pointer are the span-head quantities
pointer_diagnostic.note: pointer_hit equals pointer_logits_hit on all six cells, so no carry bypass hid a span decision; the pointer is the quantity span supervision actually moves

structural_finding.claim: The 19.2b stage gate start_hit >= 0.95 is measured on a quantity that spans supervision does not touch.
evidence_chain: read.betas is the frozen reader's own within-record position posterior: taiji/binding_copy.py line 337 computes softmax(log_row) before any span term and is only replaced by an explicit force

the span pointer enters read() as pointer_bias and is added inside _point_transport to row_logits, which produces step.pointer and s_bytes (taiji/binding_copy.py lines 361, 386-396, 467-476); it never enters betas
span_loss trains only SpanPointerHead parameters; the alpha/beta encoder, transport operator and gate numbers are untouched by design
the ledger defines start_hit = route_hit and argmax(read.betas[record]) == gold_offset (scripts/training/probe_taiji_package19.py line 255)
therefore start_hit reads route_hit * beta; a perfectly supervised span head cannot raise it
structural_finding.why_six_cells_were_not_run: With this reading fixed, all six cells fail the stage gate before any dose is applied; spending 32,256.6 CPU (68,061.4 protected) on it cannot change the verdict. The post-stage byte readings would still be informative, but the owner's decision tree keys on the stage gate first.

magnitude_attribution.start_pointer: moves under supervision: span CE -25.7% in 30 updates; 32-d untrained pointer 0.25/0.00 -> 19.5 step300 pointer 0.719/0.698
magnitude_attribution.frozen_reader_position_beta: not supervised and not movable: 0.396/0.389 on 19.5, 0.208/0.000 after 30 supervised updates
magnitude_attribution.route: 0.762/0.694 on 19.5, needs 0.95; span supervision does not touch alpha
magnitude_attribution.encoder: not the main cause (19.7: c_gamma0 content 1.000 on 5/6)
magnitude_attribution.sentence_frame: second independent gap (B arm start correct but new_description 0.260/0.229)

pending_owner_ruling.question: Should the stage gate start_hit be measured on the supervised quantity (the span pointer) while every gate number stays as written?
pending_owner_ruling.proposed_measurement_only_fix: start_hit := argmax(step.pointer[gold record]) == gold offset; route_hit stays a separate 0.95 clause; conditional_byte is conditioned on pointer start hits instead of beta start hits. Numbers 0.95 / 0.94 / 0.98 / 0.60 / 0.80 / 0.98 / 0.95 unchanged.
pending_owner_ruling.why_not_simply_add_dose: Owner rule: if start_hit passes but new_description stays near 0.26, do not add start dose. Here start_hit cannot pass at all under the current reading, so more dose is both unreadable and wasted.
pending_owner_ruling.verification_cost: <=60 Adam on a single-arm selection-stage run with the pointer reading added, about 270 CPU; no saves, no confirm
pending_owner_ruling.rejected_alternative: run the six cells anyway as a dual-reading experiment (32,256.6 CPU bare) while the stage gate is structurally unreachable

baseline_kept.note: the six 19.5 step300 bundles are untouched and remain the comparison baseline for any later 19.2b reading

cleanup_registry.kept_note: three logs, 2.9 KB total, retained as run evidence; no training bundle was produced
